title: Flux approximation on unfitted meshes and application to multiscale hybrid-mixed methods
quantity: absolute broken gradient L2 error, not coefficient-weighted
extraction: S0 and S1 values transcribed from the explicitly printed y-axis tick labels at their plotted markers; rounded published values, not original solver data. The S2 curve has no printed numeric labels and is not assigned invented precise values.
limitations: Local finite element degree and local mesh are not specified numerically for Figure 5.
Rational perturbations are inferred from rounded x-axis ticks.
Published errors use a fine standard-Galerkin numerical reference; PyMHM errors use an independently derived truncated Fourier series.
The S2 curve lies approximately between 2.5e-3 and 2.6e-3; this visual range is qualitative and not a digitized error table.
